title: Type 1 diabetes effector gene predictions (Gaulton KJ, 2021)
bodyHtml:
This list of predicted type 1 diabetes effector genes was generated by Kyle Gaulton, University of California at San Diego. Genes are assigned a tier from 1 to 5, with 1 representing the strongest evidence.

Click the "Research Method" tab to see full documentation of the supporting evidence and method. Links in the table lead to further information in the Type 1 Diabetes Knowledge Portal, the Common Metabolic Diseases Epigenome Atlas, or external resources (OMIM, Mouse Genome Database, PubMed).
